feeds.title: Workout With Pride Blog
feeds.description: Fitness can often be intimidating, and doing a class with a group of strangers is more so! At Workout with PRIDE, our passion is to create a space for all people to feel encouraged and supported while learning how to lift and exercise correctly in a fun, inclusive environment. Follow their blog to learn more about the classes, the trainer, workout regimes, and other helpful articles.

feeds.title: Prideletics Blog
feeds.description: Prideletics is just a small step within the LGBT community to connect the athletic audience that exists and bring it back to help out others. I hope this inspires you to get involved. Read our blog which covers topics like sports, events, LGBTQ-related matters, and more.

feeds.title: Decolonizing Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Decolonizing Fitness is an online resource that teaches you how to free yourself from toxic fitness culture to create more inclusive and affirming practices. Includes books, apparel, and fitness products. Go through for information about feature stories, fitness-related articles, LGBTQ topics, and more.

feeds.title: Solcana Fitness
feeds.description: Solcana Blog blog is run by Solcana Fitness, a gym based in Minneapolis, Minnesota that focuses on creating a community of people who are committed to improving their health and fitness. The blog includes articles and posts about various topics related to fitness, including exercise tips, workout routines, nutrition advice, and mindfulness practices. It also features stories and interviews with the members of the Solcana Fitness Community.

feeds.title: Q Fitness And Wellness Blog
feeds.description: Q Fitness and Wellness is the birth child of and owned/operated by, passionate fitness and wellness expert, Crem Morris-Frazier; who knew that there were often feelings of being marginalized and misunderstood within the mainstream fitness world by many in her community. For that reason, Q Fitness and Wellness is committed to providing quality, customized, culturally responsive fitness training, nutrition, and wellness services to members of the LGBTQ+ community and their allies; while also creating a safe space to connect, engage and thrive with one another.

feeds.title: The Authentic Gay » Fitness
feeds.description: The Authentic Gay blog provides our readers with the latest health, fitness, relationship, and style tips aimed at a gay male audience. The Authentic Gay cultivates an educational and fun space for LGBTQ+ individuals in which they can search for answers that will help them feed these needs necessary for higher authentic living.
